benchmark_definition: t0 and incidence classification must be documented before measurement
interpretation: Both households and banks suffered high costs, but comparable primary-source incidence has not been reconstructed.
notes: Do not use E0 to validate the central hypothesis until the documentary branch is built.

benchmark_definition: same immediate household onset required by universal-cycle claim
interpretation: No robust immediate and deep household drawdown under the inherited specifications.
notes: External-shock control; do not relabel as supporting evidence without a new treatment definition.

interpretation: Household real income falls rapidly; exact common recovery clock remains unresolved.
notes: Outcome must remain separated between registered and broad income.

benchmark_definition: first sustained family-mora increase after t0
interpretation: Household shock precedes sustained family-mora rise by about one month, but later links are not a clean linear chain.
notes: +0.3pp threshold occurs 2014-04; +0.5pp in 2014-07.

interpretation: Positive abnormal direction is robust descriptively; pretrend exists and causal attribution is not established.
notes: Annual component bridge is securities-led, not FX-led.

benchmark_definition: irregular private portfolio net of provisions / net worth
interpretation: Credit-risk exposure remains negative and far from buffer saturation despite stress.
notes: This measures solvency absorption, not profits or all risks.

interpretation: The measure protects targeted borrowers and constrains bank pricing.
notes: Regulatory sign is not universally pro-bank.

interpretation: Rate liberalization has the opposite sign from A5590/A5928.
notes: Control of policy-sign heterogeneity; not treated as a main shock episode.

basis: BCRA rule plus matched-product/disclosure work V34–V40
interpretation: Cost/risk shifts away from the borrower; systemic net-profit effect remains N/D.
notes: Strong positive falsification control against a one-sign institutional narrative.

interpretation: Dissaving rises through 2018 but remains below the 2024 peak.

interpretation: Declared use of bank/financial loans does not rise between the two 2018 halves.

interpretation: Direction is robust but pretrend is strong and magnitude is accounting-sensitive.
